tools.name: read_design
tools.description: The project's saved design: revision, the eight colour roles, heading and body typefaces, edge treatment, and which values differ from the audience's generated design.

tools.name: update_design
tools.description: Save design changes as a new project revision. Send only the values that change; null returns a value to the audience's generated design. summary is a few words for the project history.
